summary: This bill reduces the marriage duration requirement from 10 years to 5 years for divorced individuals to claim Social Security spouse or survivor benefits if a court has found them to be victims of domestic violence by their former spouse.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands eligibility for Social Security benefits to divorced individuals who were victims of domestic violence, by reducing the marriage duration requirement from 10 years to 5 years. This change broadens access to an existing social safety net program, thus expanding welfare.
